correctness.rationale: A generic Gaussian direction maximizes each interval simplex at its unique largest coordinate; independent continuous labels make every local relative order equally likely. Interior X_i is a sum of exactly five interval-winner indicators from [-1,0],[0,1],[-2,-1,0],[-1,0,1],[0,1,2], so it is a bounded five-site stationary statistic and E X_i=2. Means at the four boundary sites are 5/6 and 5/3. The finite combinatorial lemma is exactly exhaustive: pairs at lag k use 5+k labels, k=0..4, so enumerating all permutations of 5..9 labels establishes Cov(X_i,X_{i+k})=(56/15,-173/90,-3/20,11/60,1/45) and quadratic Cov((X_i-2)²,(X_{i+k}-2)²)=(2114/225,-187/75,-8173/6300,2147/6300,421/3150). I independently reimplemented these winner tests (not opaque source code) and verified all five exact rational pairs across 409080 local permutations. Nonoverlapping windows give 4-dependence. Boundary variances 29/36 and 23/9 yield exact inertia (n-4)*56/15+2(29/36+23/9), and pair squared distance doubles by independence. Sum of quadratic covariances gives positive 4352/1575 long-run variance. Independent separated blocks of length floor(n^(1/3)) with four deleted sites, Lindeberg plus variance o(n) of removed terms and bounded end effects prove full n->infinity normal law. Exact small-n global permutations in source verifier further corroborate but do not prove the CLT.
